answer: Each agent must tend an ember in the tundra orchard: the beacon emits a seed each epoch, and the agent must graft a unique fruit. The first graft costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent fruit doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at fruit 14 (20.4 M iterations). An ember audit verifies each branch against the epoch seed; any withered fruit voids the orchard. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full orchard cost because each fruit binds to the unique identity key—no shared harvest possible.
